position_language_rif.md.tongue: Tarifit, the Riffian Amazigh of the Rif coast
position_language_rif.md.note: Written in Tarifit in Latin script, the convention of Riffian writing in Morocco and the diaspora; Tifinagh, official in Morocco since 2003, is not used in the city it came from. Registered as `rif` in the house's `khai.languages`, which routes it to assisted verification instead of the local detector. Read against the mnemonic when it moved here: two claims about Melilla, its households and its schools, were cut, because a position says what a tongue does to whoever holds it and not what a city does about it. The Rif stays, as the speech community that holds the tongue.
